releasePolicy: Ship the scheduling/privacy/UI fixes independently. Optional generation and new reading/question collection remain off by default. This report does not claim all 69 end-to-end scenarios or human quality gates passed.
runtimeRoutes: useKnowledgeSyncController -> useRecommendationFeed -> RecommendationFeedCoordinator -> fetchLocalRecommendations -> shared hybrid/slate core
useKnowledgeSyncController -> useRecommendationFeed -> RecommendationFeedCoordinator -> fetchCloudRecommendations (v1 <=3 seeds) -> shared hybrid/slate core

producers.boundary: Focused, visible PDF surface with recent real input; monotonic qualified activity >=30 seconds; stable paper/day ID.
After annotation persistence succeeds; same semantic annotation revision supersedes its previous evidence; generated reviews are excluded.
After successful persisted user send; only original user input, never assistant output, streaming or unsent drafts.

storage: Existing object store: native SQLite IMMEDIATE transaction/CAS; IndexedDB equivalent for browser tests. recommendation/v2 records are excluded from device asset sync. Existing semantic_index retained.

limits.note: Account-wide provider/model caps are intentionally stricter than per-workspace caps. Unknown cloud upstream usage is disclosed. Tokens are conservative reservations, not claimed billed usage.

desktopFullSuite.method: npm test -- --shard=1/2; npm test -- --shard=2/2 on frozen source

validation.affectedTests: Final scheduler/controller regression: 23 passed; topic feedback/lifecycle set: 27 passed; recommendation UI/full-text/undo: 10 passed; all included again in the frozen full suite.
validation.browserRecommendations: 3 passed: light, dark, explicit OpenAlex PDF lookup; filters alone issue zero lookups.
validation.rust: 1.98.1 locked all-targets no-default-features check and 9 object_store tests passed on Linux; Windows result separate.
validation.sharedCore: 8 tests passed, including all three v2 pure-function tests.
validation.contracts: Passed on clean release candidate with the same runtime/build/workflow code; lockfiles and generated contracts match Git. Only this validation report was amended afterward.
validation.build: npm run ci:smoke and npm run build passed on final runtime source.

findings: Sidebar test queried the dialog synchronously before portal mount. It now awaits the accessible input and filtered row.

Geometry/theme recommendation fixtures omitted required relevanceScore and were correctly excluded by the new quality gate. Fixtures now supply explicit relevant scores; production thresholds and behavioral assertions are unchanged.

nativeBoundary: Windows index benchmark uses 10k assets/50k fragments at 768 dimensions. Peak whole test-process RSS includes index creation; it is not claimed as incremental app RSS. This does not measure native window focus, sleep, first-screen latency or manual installer UX.
